name: @data-lineage/shared
description: Shared utilities for data lineage monorepo

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const indexContent='import { jsonUtil, fastParse, fastStringify, safeJsonParse, safeJsonStringify, jsonCompare, jsonClone, isValidJson, devalueSerialize, devalueDeserialize } from \\'./utils/json.esm.js\\';\n\nexport { jsonUtil, fastParse, fastStringify, safeJsonParse, safeJsonStringify, jsonCompare, jsonClone, isValidJson, devalueSerialize, devalueDeserialize };'; fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.esm.js', indexContent);"
